content: Sekemi Daina I Lib yaka Baena Nunau Hi Taulol
Lan etega Daina, Yakobo ge Leya natuliya yovana, i tagil i na labi o yowauiliyau i kitel.
Heimo gagama Hivi, iya labi o ana tonowak bwabwatana, natuna tauina alana Sekemi. Sauga Sekemi Daina i kite, inoke i lib ge i loneganega-an.
Sekemi Yakobo natuna Daina i hebabale ge i nunuwana-an, yaka baaba luluvena i baubaunan elana tage nuwana ni ba ahe.
Yaka abwe i baek tamana Heimo elana i ba, “Yova o nu ahe lagou.”

Sauga Yakobo wasa i hago Sekemi Daina i lib ge i loneganega-an, he sauga o elana natunau bolau heliya iyoho wana bwasumu hi matamatahikagil uleya. Inoke i anagugumwan nige bugul etega i giginol, i matamatan nihi sikal elana.
Yaka Sekemi tamana Heimo i na alona Yakobo nihi liwaliwan, ge Sekemi al i toulil.

He Yakobo natunau nuliya wasana iyaka hi hago, ge hi vin, hi sikalem uleya. Nuwaliya i nak ge hi huga nabi, kaiwena ginol toto Sekemi i ginol Yakobo natuna elana, iya ginol pulupuluwawena hot boda Isileli mataliyaa, ginol ololana bahi gamagalau nihi giginol.
Heimo i baek elal i ba, “Natu Sekemi natumiu meluyovana i hebabale. He ya awanun eliyamiu, nuku talamwan elana ge ni alolonan.
Inoke alomeyau komiu ta alolon nem nowa. Natumiyau yowau nuku talamwagil alomeyau naha alolon, ge natumeyau yowau nuku ahel alomiyau nuku alolon.
Inoke alomeyau komiu ta mina. Wama panuwa labena gegewena i mwapwela eliyamiu, inoke nuku minaa, nuku nem nowa-an, ge enuna nuku pwamola wami bilibili.”
Yaka Sekemi i baek Daina tamana ge nunau elal i ba, “No nuwatu nuku yaliyaya-an, yaka hauna gun nuku awanuni, nasi na pewa eliyamiu.
Bwagana yova molana ge ami mulolu ali bwata ga nuku teli ola, hauna gun nuku awanuni, nasi na pewa. Iyai te yova nuku talamwan ge na alolonan.”
Yakobo natunau hi nuwanuwatu ginol nanakina kaiwena, toto Sekemi i ginola nuliya elana. Inoke alona wali kakawi hi baek Sekemi ge tamana Heimo elal,
hi ba, “Nige bosowaina numa naha talamwan tau etega elana, toto nige tuwana buhuna kunisina hi gogotomwa yoho. Ebo naha ginol ola o, nasi naha puluwawi nabi.
Nige wami awanun naha tatalamwi ana siga ebo wami bolau gegewel tuwaliya buhuna kunisina nihi gotomwa yoho ge nuku ola ama.
Yaka abwe natumeyau yowau naha talamwagil alomiyau nuku alolon, ge natumiyau yowau naha ahel alomeyau naha alolon. Yaka alomeyau komiu ta mina ala boda maisena.
Yaa ebo nige wama baaba nuku hahago ge gotomwa yoho paganina nuku giginol, he numa ha aahe ha eegon.”
Inoke Heimo alona ge natuna Sekemi nuwatu o hi awa wawaisi-an.
Yaka Sekemi etimwawa i na i ginol ola wali baaba, kaiwena Yakobo natuna meluyovana i hebabale hoti. He Sekemi ana awatauwan i bwata tamana wana limi ana heniheni ge tutunau gamwaliyaa.
Yaka alona ge tamana hi nok hi na abamimigogowa panuwa ana gana ana abauluulutuka. Inoke hi liwaliwan wali panuwa bolauiliyau elal,

hi ba, “Bolau ya heliya gamagalau waiwaisal hi nununuwana. He nihi minaa wala panuwaa ge nihi nem nowa-an. Wala labi i bwata heliya ge kila bosowaila ya. Natuliyau yowau ta ahel ta alolonagil, ge natulau yowau ta talamwagil nihi alolonagil.
Yaa nige nihi tatalam avalau ta mimina ala boda maisena, ana siga ebo kila bolau gegewela gogotomwa yoho paganina ta ginol ge ta ola heliya.
Ta ginol ola to, yaka wali bwasumu ge wali gogomwau gegewena kila wala bugul. He wali nuwatu ta talamwi, yaka avalau ta mipamaisena.”

Inoke bolau bolo abamimigogowa panuwa ana gana ana abauluulutuka, gegewel Heimo ge natuna Sekemi wali baaba hi awa wawaisi-an. Yaka panuwa o bolauiliyau gegewel tuwaliya buhuna kunisina hi gotomwa yoho.

Lan eton i mowasi, bolau ali gotomwa yoho lomwanina iyaho ya ge nige hi nunuwatu tage abwe nak etega ni gan. Inoke Yakobo natunau eluwa Simiyon ge Libai, heliya Daina nunau hot, wali elohaveyan kilepana hi ahel hi na hi ulutuk panuwa gamwanaa, yaka bolau gegewel hi lolil habal,
aloliyau Heimo ge natuna Sekemi. Yaka Daina hi ahe Sekemi wana limiya ge hi egon.
Yaka abwe Yakobo natunau bolau enuna hi na bugubugul hi aheliya toyaomal tuwaliyaa, ge panuwa o ana gogomwau gegewel hi oel, Sekemi wana ginol nanakina nuliya elana lahena.
He wali sipi, wali bulumwakau, ge wali donki, bolo panuwa gamwanaa o ebo tolinaa, hi bugulan.
I ola al wali wasawasa buguliliyau gegewel, ge yowau gegewel avaliyau ge wawayau, bugul gegewel limi gamwaliyaa, hi oel.

Yaka abwe Yakobo i baek Simiyon ge Libai elal i ba, “Komiu o pulowan iyaka ku ginol. Alau iyaka ku apapanak-an, Kenani ge Pelisi ge labi ya gamagaliliyau gegewel nihi awa bwaibwaikikin-agau. He kila nige ta gegewi, inoke ebo ali boda nihi pamaisena ge nihi haveyan eliyala, nasi alowau ge o heniheni gegewela nihi pwamowasela.”
Yaa alona wali huga anana hi lahe hi ba, “Age waisi o, ebo numa ni ginol olaan ni ola iya tololoneganega?”
